promptEs: Escuchá el compás de 4/4 y elegí la secuencia de duraciones que corresponde.
promptEn: Listen to the 4/4 measure and choose the sequence of durations that matches.
explanationEs: El patrón tiene cuatro corcheas seguidas y una blanca: 0,5 + 0,5 + 0,5 + 0,5 + 2 = 4 tiempos. Las corcheas ocupan los dos primeros tiempos y la blanca los dos últimos.
explanationEn: The pattern has four eighth notes in a row and a half note: 0.5 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 2 = 4 beats. The eighth notes take the first two beats and the half note the last two.
choicesEn: Eighth note, Eighth note, Eighth note, Eighth note, Half note
Eighth note, Eighth note, Quarter note, Eighth note, Half note
Quarter note, Eighth note, Eighth note, Eighth note, Half note
Eighth note, Eighth note, Eighth note, Quarter note, Quarter note
